policies.text: Authorization to offer multi-territory tour packages is granted to firms holding a verified Master Tour Operator License.
Recommendation for top-tier official charter agreements requires meeting premier operator standing together with possessing a valid FAA Part 135 Air Carrier Certificate.

Continuous dispatch assistance is available if an organization completes at least 10 monthly emergency transport reroutings, logs 35 or more monthly group bookings, or records a minimum of 20 monthly VIP transfers.
Priority transport assignment is granted if annual flight investment reaches at least $400,000 while maintaining a valid ISO 27001 Security Certification.
Assigning a dedicated account representative requires an account to have high-volume account status.
Maritime freight endorsement is granted to shipping entities that operate a minimum of 5 cargo vessels.
Premier operator standing is recognized when an aviation provider maintains a minimum fleet count of 10 aircraft and achieves a quarterly punctual departure score of 90 percent or higher.
Qualification for regional transport growth requires a quarterly schedule of at least 120 daily active routes.
High-volume account status is assigned when monthly group bookings equal 30 or more alongside an active ISO 27001 Security Certification.
Preferred lodging partner classification requires maintaining a passenger satisfaction rating of 85 percent or higher across all quarterly surveys.
